title: On Screen Keyboard or other ideas?

posts.author: Solvita
posts.body:
Hello Folks!
Im new to RPG Maker, and i run into my first issue:
I have created a Character Creator, everything is working fine - the Problem is, if its running on a device without a Keyboard, its not possible to start the Game, because the Window of typing only works with Input.
So is it possible to open the Android Keyboard or something like this? Its just a typing box for the Character Name.
Maybe someone have a idea.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Your question is odd, because by default RPG Maker MZ does
not
recognize keys for typing at all. It's the opposite of what you're describing.
The Name Input window can be navigated by clicking or pressing directly on the letters. Typing doesn't do anything unless you've modified your game with a plugin - in which case, you should deploy your game without that plugin for Android.
